item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 24/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cold weather to the coast of Guangdong this morning, and will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be a few rain patches over Guangdong midweek this week. A humid maritime airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend to early next week. It will be warm during the day and misty over the region.

Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, becoming east force 5 later, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy periods in the morning. Becoming fine and dry during the day.
Temp range: 13 - 17 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
